title: Doors, food, and a warm welcome
description: Meet owners, offer the room QR and paper route. Keep the opening on time.

title: Find out who is here
description: Welcome, two short polls, why the night is free, and what they will leave with.

title: The work wrapped around the work
description: Tell the logistics story. Help the room recognize a worthwhile job.

title: Customer-first live makeover
description: Paul diagnoses the customer question. Jimmy builds the brief and draft. The owner judges it.

title: Let the room try it
description: Send a tool to phones. Work in pairs if useful. Check who has a draft or a clear first step.

title: Five-minute reset
description: Keep the QR and question box open. Return at 8:10.

title: A practical helper, checked in public
description: Turn rough notes into a CRM record. Jimmy helps refine instructions. Paul verifies the result.

title: Choose a first helper
description: Complete the job, information, result, check, and Friday step. Offer the first-job tool to unsure owners.

title: The room’s questions
description: Answer the top moderated questions. Clarify what needs separate setup.

title: The optional next step
description: Explain the agreed audit and 15-minute call. No deposits. No new prices or payment terms.

title: Save the work. Finish on time.
description: Confirm tools and notes are saved. Choose Friday’s first step. Thank every owner.
